name: VA HOME ADMIN PWA MOBILE STABILITY
changes: Prevents iOS focus zoom in the private Admin PWA by restoring 16 px mobile form controls and hardening the viewport
Rebuilds New Order on mobile as a safe-area-aware full-screen sheet with a dedicated scroll body and compact action footer
Fixes conditional Nova Poshta branch versus courier fields so mutually exclusive delivery inputs never render together

No Supabase migration or Edge Function deployment is required for v16.3.2.
Existing create-order and admin-order-update server validation flows remain untouched.
